properties.name: One number corrected at cut time: the layout section said 55 edge types, which PERFORMED_IN made false. Same class the doc-version gate exists for — a claim about the build that the build no longer supports. The dated record in docs/backlog.md saying rung 1 shipped "28 node / 55 edge types" was deliberately LEFT ALONE: that is history, and rewriting it would falsify what happened rather than correct a current claim.
